principle_violations.reason: The Square and Circle classes do not appropriately implement the volume method of the Shape interface. Instead of raising an exception, these classes should provide an implementation or abstain from it if conceptually incorrect.
principle_violations.suggestion: Refactor the design to separate 2D shapes from 3D shapes, allowing them to implement appropriate interfaces.

principle_violations.reason: The VolumeCalculator class inherits from AreaCalculator but overrides its sum method to calculate volumes. If new calculation types are needed, this class will have to change.
principle_violations.suggestion: Create separate calculator classes for each type of measurement that conform to a general interface or base class.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
